subject: Onboarding docs: insurance scope, endorsement wording, and PO billing contact

Subject: Re: Onboarding checklist & insurance items

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the welcome — attaching SecureData's initial packet to get set up for PO and billing. Included: a current COI (General and Professional Liability), our W9, and a short vendor profile. Please confirm whether anything else is needed to route invoices and complete the vendor record.

A couple quick notes:
- Our COI lists umbrella coverage and limits per our carrier; we were under the impression Redwood accepts the umbrella but please let us know if you need the endorsement to name Redwood as an additional insured.
- If you require a specific endorsement form or language, we can request it from our broker but need the exact wording.

Files attached: SecureData_COI_2026.pdf (2MB), SecureData_W9.pdf (45KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding checklist & insurance items

Laura — thanks for sending these over and for the quick packet. Confirming receipt of the COI and W9. A few clarifying items so we can finish supplier activation and issue a PO: 

1) Endorsement language: Our contracts team needs an Additional Insured endorsement on the General Liability policy with the following clause (exact):
"Redwood Inference, its affiliates, officers, directors, employees and agents shall be named as Additional Insured for ongoing operations and products-completed operations."

2) Waiver of subrogation: For Professional Liability, we typically ask for a waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood for covered work where applicable. If your policy cannot provide that, let us know and include the carrier's position.

3) Effective dates / retroactive date: The COI you sent shows coverage through 11/2026; please confirm the policy inception and any retroactive date on the PL policy if applicable.

4) Billing & PO contact: who should Redwood invoice for consumption/implementation fees and to what billing email should we route PO/invoice? We will also need the legal entity name exactly as you want it on the PO and the tax id (we have W9 but want to confirm the remittance name).

Kimberly & Mina — can you confirm whether the endorsement language above is OK or whether we should accept the umbrella wording? If an endorsement form is required, please advise and I'll request it from SecureData.

Laura — once we have the endorsement language and billing contact I can kick off the PO and route to procurement for a standard Net30. If there are timing constraints on your side for when the PO must arrive, flag that and we'll expedite.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@securedata.io>

Thanks Marcus — quick replies inline:

> endorsement language (exact)
We can request the Additional Insured endorsement with that exact language; our broker expects ~3-5 business days once we submit the request.

> waiver of subrogation
Carrier says they can provide a limited waiver of subrogation for Professional Liability in favor of Redwood where permitted by law; they'll flag any exclusions when they issue the endorsement.

> effective/retroactive date
The PL policy has a retroactive date of 2023-04-01; GL effective 12/01/2025 through 12/01/2026.

> billing/contact for PO
Please issue the PO to: SecureData Inc. (legal name)
Tax ID: 94-1112233 (matches W9)
Primary billing contact: James Hall <j.hall@securedata.io> — invoices@securedata.io is monitored for AP.

We attached here the same COI and W9 again for your records. If you need the broker contact I can include them in the thread.

Let us know when you submit the endorsement request and any templated wording your team prefers we supply to the broker.

Laura

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@securedata.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding checklist & insurance items

Hi all — quick insurance checklist from our side to close activation: 

- Additional Insured endorsement: the exact clause Marcus pasted is acceptable. Please ask your broker to provide an endorsement PDF naming "Redwood Inference, its affiliates, officers, directors, employees and agents" as Additional Insured for ongoing operations and products-completed operations.
- Waiver of subrogation: limited waiver on Professional Liability is acceptable; please have the broker note any exceptions.
- Certificate must show policy limits for GL of at least $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate and E&O/PL limits of at least $1M. Your COI meets those limits per the file we received but endorsement is required for Additional Insured.
- Retroactive date: thank you for confirming — acceptable.

Next steps and timeline: once Laura confirms the broker has submitted the endorsement request, we will hold activation for up to 7 business days for the endorsement to be issued. If it is delayed beyond that, Marcus can approve a conditional PO with activation contingent on endorsement receipt (we will add a note on the PO to reflect conditional start).

Marcus — please proceed to create the PO to SecureData Inc with billing contact James Hall (invoices@securedata.io). Mark PO as Net30; include reference to contract SD-4627. If you run into any procurement limits or need an SLA exception to go live before endorsement is in-hand, loop me and Marissa.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Insurance & Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
